headline: Modular Unifies AI Development with Mojo and MAX
lede: The Modular platform bridges low-level hardware optimization and high-level model deployment. By combining the high-performance Mojo language with the MAX inference server, it creates a cohesive ecosystem for scaling AI infrastructure.

headline: Inject Engineering Rigor into Your AI Coding Assistants
lede: Matt Pocock’s skills library moves beyond vibe coding by enforcing structured software methodologies. These lightweight modules ensure your AI agents prioritize architectural health and TDD standards.

headline: Reclaim Your Hardware with OpenLogi
lede: OpenLogi provides a native, account-free alternative to bloated proprietary peripheral software. Built on Rust, this tool puts hardware control back into the user's hands through transparent TOML configuration files.

headline: Superpowers Standardizes Multi-Stage AI Development
lede: The Superpowers framework transforms coding agents into disciplined engineering partners. It mandates task decomposition and test-driven development to prevent context loss during complex, long-running coding sessions.

headline: Cursor Plugins Modularize AI Editor Capabilities
lede: The new plugin marketplace turns the Cursor editor into a central control plane for professional productivity. Developers can now integrate enterprise data and automated workflows directly into their IDE.

headline: Automate Job Applications with AI-Driven Career Ops
lede: Career-Ops functions as a command-line control center for navigating modern job markets. It filters roles against structured rubrics and generates optimized materials while keeping the human in the loop.

headline: Maintain Consistent State Across AI Agent Sessions
lede: The ai-memory middleware captures project lifecycle observations to prevent vendor lock-in. It provides a shared, portable knowledge base that persists architectural decisions regardless of which agent you choose to employ.

headline: MoneyPrinterTurbo Automates Full-Cycle Video Production
lede: This all-in-one automation tool manages everything from script generation to video deployment. It empowers creators to scale content production through a flexible, plugin-driven AI architecture.

headline: Agent Substrate Optimizes High-Density Agent Deployments
lede: Agent Substrate enables massive oversubscription of compute resources by hibernating idle agents. This control plane brings stability and efficiency to large-scale, stateful agent swarms in Kubernetes environments.

headline: Munder Difflin Orchestrates Multi-Agent Office Teams
lede: Munder Difflin visualizes agent collaboration by wrapping terminal CLIs in a simulated office floor. This framework uses a central orchestrator to manage task routing and semantic memory between independent AI agents.
